g.text: Eighth KKT against all five MST comparators
Solid points pool all 24 trials; faint markers show four six-trial realizations. Two graphs × two sampling seeds; repetitions reuse each realization.
All cases, controls, losses and trial ranges remain. No control normalization or historical pooling. Ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Lines connect tested endpoints without threshold interpolation. All 0 flagged calls retained. Both policies use the same compressed verifier.
Ratio charts: dashed 1.00 is parity; dotted 0.90 is a 10% lead. A crossover needs an earlier loss and a later strong lead on all four realizations and both clocks.
